title: FoveaWAM: Role-Aware 4D World-Action Modeling for Dynamic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.31705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To manipulate a moving object, a policy must predict the scene at the moment its action executes, yet every millisecond spent predicting pushes that moment further away. Scene-level forecasts are computationally expensive, whereas target-centric forecasts can omit nearby objects that affect contact. Our key insight is that what a policy must predict decouples by role: only the target's pose, which determines contact, requires millimeter precision, while the surroundings matter primarily through the clearance they leave and the motion they impart. We present FoveaWAM, a native 4D world-action model that allocates precision according to these roles. Specifically, it models the target's past and future motion as a metric SE(3) trajectory, the surroundings as sparse 3D flow, and relies on the current frame for everything static. This compact representation lets FoveaWAM act in 15.1 ms on one RTX 5090, about 10 times faster than video world

translated_title: FoveaWAM：面向动态操作的基于角色感知的4D世界-动作建模
translated_abstract: 要操作一个正在移动的物体，策略必须预测其动作执行那一刻的场景，然而预测所耗费的每一毫秒都会让那一刻进一步远离。场景级的预测计算代价高昂，而以目标为中心的预测又可能遗漏影响接触的附近物体。我们的核心洞察是：策略需要预测的内容可以按角色解耦——只有决定接触的目标位姿需要毫米级精度，而周围环境主要通过其留下的间隙空间和施加的运动来产生影响。我们提出了FoveaWAM，一种原生4D世界-动作模型，它根据这些角色来分配预测精度。具体而言，该模型将目标的过去与未来运动建模为度量的SE(3)轨迹，将周围环境建模为稀疏3D流，并对所有静态内容直接依赖当前帧。这种紧凑的表示使FoveaWAM能够在单块RTX 5090上以15.1毫秒的速度执行动作，比视频世界模型快约10倍（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: FoveaWAM提出按角色分配预测精度的原生4D世界-动作模型，仅对目标位姿采用毫米级SE(3)轨迹预测、对环境用稀疏3D流建模、对静态内容依赖当前帧，从而以15.1毫秒的低延迟实现动态移动物体的高效操作。
en_tdlr: FoveaWAM is a role-aware native 4D world-action model that predicts the target's motion as a metric SE(3) trajectory and the surroundings as sparse 3D flow, enabling dynamic manipulation in 15.1 ms—about 10× faster than video world models.
